src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasMountRuntime.h:128-134 documents exactly this: 'A caller admitted from this hook must be refused: the old generation is already dead, while the new generation is not live until lost is cleared.' Lines 142-153 (fence-generation admission) implement the 'dead lane cannot land a conditional create under a successor generation' rule: a captured fenceGeneration() is re-checked immediately before every durable backend call, and a mismatch (generation moved) throws a typed transient refusal via checkFenceOrThrow.

docs/superpowers/models/CaCasMountCore.tla's slot-occupy design (comment block ~1300-1330 and WedgeRetryOccupied action) implements exactly this: 'None is Created (absent, so a conditional create lands)'; three resolution branches on the raw GET result -- Occupied(EpochSeal) conclusive rejection, Occupied(bytes)-ours (adopt+replay, ack only now), Occupied(bytes)-someone-else's (no ack) -- with 'SabSlotNoByteCompare merges branch 3 into branch 2: it acks without comparing' as the sabotage this design rejects, i.e. caller-side byte adjudication without compare-and-throw is exactly the honest design.
